note: Kill-test rig. PAPER ONLY - no keys, no signing, no orders. Do not tune after data starts.
_credential_note: Only the RPC/api-key fields on kt_lib.CRED_ALLOWLIST are read from legion_config_path. Private keys and seed phrases in that file are never read, returned or logged. Env vars override the config.

detection._note: v3.2: poll_interval_sec is set to what the MEASURED RPC burn supports, not to the 60s the v3.1 registration assumed. Measured burn at 130s was ~49,000/day against the 40,000 cap, hence 220s. The registered 60s is arithmetically incompatible with the cap once Tier B actually records the signals its 900s allowance entitles it to -- see PREREGISTRATION_v3.md amendment v3.2, 'The RPC budget'. Historical note: 3s polling burned ~300 RPC/min for no benefit.
detection._latency_note: max_signal_latency_sec_for_primary (60s) is the v1 primary-pool rule and is still read by kt_verdict.py -- deliberately NOT repointed at v3, so the settled v1 verdict cannot be re-litigated. v3 uses max_signal_latency_sec_for_v3 (900s), read by kt_wallets.py.

_wallet_note: Top-20 by trade frequency, frozen before results. Selected for websocket stability, not performance.
_free_rpc_note: Helius and GetBlock are out of credits. Working free HTTP: Alchemy (rate-limits under load) and api.mainnet-beta.solana.com. The rig probes for a data-returning endpoint and fails over.
_free_ws_note: VERIFIED by probe_ws.py: wss://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com delivers logsSubscribe in ~1s. Alchemy/dRPC websockets connect but deliver nothing. PREFERRED_WS puts the working ones first, and a 90s silence watchdog rotates automatically if one goes quiet.
_v3_note: Tier A = wallets_frozen.json via websocket (20). Tier B = wallets_v3_poll.json (300-wallet deterministic random sample of wallets_v3.json's 4533) polled in rotation. Signals are tagged tier A/B. Latency allowance for v3 is <=900s per PREREGISTRATION_v3.md amendment v3.1.
_v32_note: AMENDMENT v3.2 (2026-10-10), before examining any v3 holdout data. (1) max_signal_age_sec was 180s, contradicting the registered <=900s v3 allowance; it silently discarded 59% of Tier B while discarding 0% of Tier A, biasing the test toward the frequency-ranked tier. It is now 900s AND fingerprinted (removed from _FP_IGNORE_EXACT) so this can never be pooled over again. (2) Age is now checked from the getSignaturesForAddress blockTime BEFORE spending a getTransaction, so out-of-allowance signatures cost no RPC. (3) poll_sig_limit raised 4 -> 25 (same one RPC call) so active wallets are no longer truncated to their 4 most recent transactions. (4) kt_wallets.py read a hard-coded 60s latency cap -- the v1 rule -- instead of the registered v3 allowance; it now reads max_signal_latency_sec_for_v3 and draws K from Tier B only, reporting the A+B union as a secondary.
_release_note: Example config for the public release. Fill in legion_config_path / RPC keys yourself, or run with no credentials against the public RPC.
